reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her note closing the incident that evening said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address for Southgate. The channel doesn't give one, and there are no Tansley account files in the share that he can see. I told him to ask Priyanka or the account team if he needs the full address.
